title: The first whole-line gradient bank is invalidated pending anchor-hull replay

remainder_correction.finding: The order-eight Taylor polynomial was centered at K1787, but the degree-eight derivative enclosure covered only each target leaf. Taylor's intermediate-point remainder requires the complete anchor-to-leaf hull whenever the anchor is outside the leaf.
remainder_correction.effect: All ten reported stationary exclusions are withdrawn. The completed bytes remain method-development evidence only and cannot support K1819 or K1820.
remainder_correction.repair: Recompute every candidate with the derivative enclosure on the axis-aligned hull of the K1787 anchor and the exact target leaf, using configuration-distinct checkpoints.

certificate.corrected_parameter_remainder_domain: axis-aligned hull of the K1787 anchor and exact target leaf

scope_guard: No stationary exclusion from the invalidated leaf-only remainder bank is admissible. K1816's 26 compact value certificates and K1787's named local stationary point remain unchanged; all 52 candidate leaves, the exposed boundary and global admission remain open.
